title: Equivariant algebra on the split components
statement: Let H and C be commutative rings, C an H-algebra, G a group, rho:G -> End_H(C) a family, d a natural number, and alpha:G -> Perm(Fin d) a group homomorphism. The equivariant algebra is the explicitly constructed H-subalgebra of functions f:Fin d -> C such that rho(a)(f(i))=f(alpha(a)(i)) for every a and i, implemented as the intersection of the equalizers of rho(a) composed with evaluation at i and evaluation at alpha(a)(i).
